The 2024 decree n° 804.24.2, implementing law n° 82-21 on electrical self-production, reinforces this initiative while highlighting challenges related to social acceptability, appropriation, and organizational engagement toward AI.Leveraging comprehensive documentary analysis and semi-structured interviews with ONEE executives and engineers, this study investigates how organizational perception and engagement can foster AI acceptance and appropriation. Results reveal a positive AI perception among executives (70%) and engineers (75%), demonstrating significant organizational commitment. The research identifies regulatory, ethical, technological, socioeconomic, communication, and environmental challenges.While focused on ONEE's leadership and technical personnel, the study provides valuable insights into AI's potential for modernizing Morocco's electrical infrastructure. The hierarchical challenge analysis offers strategic guidance for technological integration. A complementary consumer perception study is planned for early 2025 to further explore societal implications.

articleTitle: Transformational Leadership and Digital Innovation: The Moderating Role of Diversity in Shaping Work Behavior among Indonesian Employees (MGA View)
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study examines how gender, age, and education moderate the relationship between transformational leadership and digital innovative work behavior (DIWB) in diverse employee groups. The paper addresses a literature gap on how leadership styles and diversity foster innovation in digital work environments. The study analyzes data from 514 Greater Jakarta employees using PLS-SEM in a cross-sectional quantitative design. Transformational leadership's direct and moderating effects on DIWB are examined, taking demographic factors like gender, age, and education into account. Transformational leadership significantly affects DIWB across all employee groups. This relationship is moderated by diversity, with gender, age, and education all contributing. The growing body of leadership and innovation research emphasizes the importance of diversity in leadership effectiveness. Cross-sectional studies limit causal inferences. Future longitudinal research could examine organizational culture and other moderators. The findings can be used to tailor diversity-aware leadership strategies to boost innovation and create an inclusive workplace. Unlike previous research focusing solely on leadership effects, this study integrates diversity factors into transformational leadership and DIWB.

articleTitle: Observer based controller to stabilize linear systems delays
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this paper, an observer-based functional controllers to stabilize delayed linear systems is designed. Delays, whether constant or variable, are a major challenge for the stability of dynamic systems, they generate oscillations and divergence. To overcome these challenges, Linear Matrix Inequality-based methods is used for the design of robust observers capable of compensating for the effects of delays. This problem-based approach is illustrated by numerical examples, which highlight the effectiveness of the presented approach.

articleTitle: Emerging Technologies in Photovoltaic-Thermal (PVT) Systems: A Review of Cooling Strategies, Material Advances, and Configurations
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The dual challenges of rising global energy demand and environmental degradation necessitate innovative approaches to harness renewable energy efficiently. This review investigates recent advancements in PVT systems, emphasizing thermal management, materials, and configurations. Results compiled from literature reveal that nanofluid-based systems enhance thermal conductivity and cooling performance compared to conventional fluids, while phase-change materials and dual-fluid configurations support temperature regulation and energy storage. Selective absorber coatings and bifacial PV modules contribute to improved optical-thermal efficiency and broader energy capture. Additionally, innovations like CPVT and BIPVT systems have enabled integration into industrial, residential, and off-grid contexts, with compact and scalable designs supporting modular deployment. Structured tables summarize performance trends across configurations, highlighting the effectiveness of radiative cooling, hybrid PCM integration, and advanced glazing in varying climates. Despite these advances, recurring challenges include material cost, performance degradation under harsh conditions, and integration into existing infrastructure. This review synthesizes current progress and highlights future research opportunities, providing a comprehensive understanding of the potential and limitations of PVT systems in addressing global energy sustainability goals.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex Cooperative Rate Splitting Multiple Access with Imperfect CSI and Imperfect SIC
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Rate splitting multiple access (RSMA) is one of the promising multiple access techniques in 6G. One of the limitations of RSMA is that the rate is limited by the worst user’s rate. Cooperative rate splitting multiple access (C-RSMA) has become an essential technique to overcome this limitation. In this work, a downlink full-duplex C-RSMA with imperfect channel state information (ICSI) and imperfect successive interference cancellation (ISIC) is considered. Full-duplex (FD) relaying is used to fully utilize the channel in order to enhance the system performance. The objective is to maximize the minimum rate of the users, while ensuring that the transmission latency for each user’s rate does not exceed a specified threshold. Success convex approximation (SCA) is used to optimize the precoding matrix, common rate allocation, and the relay power. Numerical results show that the proposed system improves the Max-Min rate compared to the other systems.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Production Technologies: A Review
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Hydrogen is a clean energy source that can help us move to sustainable energy. This review looks at how we can produce hydrogen, focusing on making green hydrogen with renewable energy. It talks about old methods like steam reforming and electrolysis, and new ways like using solar and wind power or biomass. The review checks how each method works, how much it costs, how big it can get, and its impact on the environment. It also looks at new technologies and how renewables can improve performance. The review ends by saying we need more innovation and policy support to solve current problems and use hydrogen on a large scale.

articleTitle: Preliminary results of implementing a machine-learning pipeline for predicting the risk of imminent osteoporosis fracture
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study presents a Machine Learning pipeline for predicting imminent fracture risk in osteoporotic patients using non-invasive clinical data. Based on a cleaned dataset of 3,718 records from the Ontario Osteoporosis Strategy, several ML models were evaluated. The Soft Voting classifier outperformed other approaches, achieving 76.0% accuracy, 74.0% F1-score, 76.0% recall, and 73.0% precision. Among individual models, the Support Vector Machine performed best with 70.8% accuracy. Key predictors included age, weight, and fall history. These results highlight the potential of Machine Learning to support cost-effective imminent fracture risk prediction and enable early, personalized interventions in osteoporosis care.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Cyber-Physical Systems via Dynamic Feedback Linearization and Linear Matrix Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Nonlinear control is a challenging aspect in modeling and controlling complex systems, specifically Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), where the system dynamics are inherently nonlinear. Robotics and autonomous vehicle applications mandate the need for stability and robustness guarantees despite such nonlinearities. This paper addresses these challenges by employing dynamic feedback linearization, which extends classical feedback linearization by incorporating dynamic compensators to transform nonlinear systems into linear systems via appropriate state, feedback, and compensator transformations. The linear system can be altered to incorporate classical control techniques in a simpler form to analyze. Moreover, the stability of the transformed system will be analyzed extensively based on Lyapunov quadratic functions and Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs) to come up with a robust and systematic toolbox for stability analysis. Additionally, its applicative effectiveness to an autonomous vehicle model will demonstrate its usefulness for addressing practical CPS scenarios. This work develops novel knowledge regarding the behavior of nonlinear systems in the framework of stability, and this is crucial for the design and deployment of CPSs in complex applications.

articleTitle: Mechanical Stability Modelling of Peatland with Coupled Hydro-Mechanical Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The mechanical stability of the peatlands is essential to be analyzed because it influences gas emissions and has a significant effect on global carbon cycling. Peatlands have the highest carbon storage capacity compared with the other terrestrial ecosystems because of their water-saturated environment. The total carbon stored in peatlands is about 600 gigatonnes or 30% of global soil carbon stock. The rate of carbon accumulation in peatlands is around 0.09-0.5 gigatonnes per year and equivalent to 1%-5% of yearly global greenhouse emissions. The mechanical stability of the peat will depend on the peat shear strength and the behavior of the pore fluid. We present initial results from a simulation model to analyze peat mechanical stability using a coupled hydro-mechanical approach. Compared to the uncoupled method, this formulation is conceptually more complete because the solid displacement and pore fluid pressure are solved simultaneously. To validate the algorithm, we compare the numerical solution with the analytical solution of Mandel’s problem. We assume the peatland shape is semi-ellipse when viewed in a vertical cross-section (two-dimension). We use two layers model, saturated and unsaturated, to accommodate peatland characteristics with the substrate properties are impermeable, stiff, and no deformation.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Generative Modeling and Optimization for Ethical and Scalable Selection Systems: A Multi-Domain Scoping Review
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) transforms selection and recommendation systems by enabling automated optimization, enhanced personalization, and intelligent decision-making. This scoping review surveys the integration of GAI-driven selection models across domains, such as recruitment, healthcare, education, and e-commerce, demonstrating improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. AI-enhanced personal selection, healthcare decision support systems, and generative adversarial networks (GANs) for personalized selection illustrate the impact of synthetic data generation and deep learning on optimizing user experience. Despite these advancements, ethical concerns, including algorithmic bias, transparency, and data privacy, remain important challenges. By consolidating state-of-the-art approaches and methodologies, this review maps key advancements, identifies research gaps, and proposes future directions to ensure responsible and scalable deployment of Generative AI in selection and recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Evaluating Regression Models for Project Forecasting: A Comparative Analysis of Linear and Polynomial Approaches with Monte Carlo Simulations
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this study, we investigate regression prediction schemes and apply them to planning as an extension to predicting future outcomes of projects using Monte Carlo simulations. Project completion probabilities were modeled using cumulative distribution functions (CDF) with linear and polynomial regression models. Linear regression was conducted first, but residuals revealed a high prediction error and the focus was quickly shifted to polynomial regression which increased accuracy substantially. Polynomial regression outperformed the others in capturing the non-linear data patterns and demonstrated low values of mean squared error (MSE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) by making the fitted values close to the actual prices of the test set. Offering trustworthy estimates on project completion this way helps improve decision-making. Thus, further exploration of non-linear methods might aid in maximizing the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Cyber Threats Analysis on Connected Vehicles, CAN System, and the Role of AI
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The cybersecurity market for connected vehicles is estimated at $2.9 billion in 2022, with a projection of $10.3 billion by 2032. This cost increase highlights the urgency and criticality of the situation in the face of cyber-attacks. The purpose of this paper is to understand the current issues and to study the proposed solutions in the security of connected vehicles. We will start by understanding the challenges of cyber security through real cases, to then study the vulnerabilities of communication protocols exploited by cyber attackers, notably the CAN standardized protocol and finally to study the innovation proposed at this level and identify the role of AI. This study aimed to demonstrate how urban mobility is at risk against the expertise of cyber attackers in violating the communication systems of connected vehicles, even if they are standardized and old. We concluded by demonstrating how, using AI and prevention systems against cyber-attacks, we can secure them.

articleTitle: Enhancing U-Net Performance in Retinopathy Segmentation using Metaheuristic Search Space Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Image segmentation plays a vital role in medical decision-making, significantly improving the efficiency and effectiveness of healthcare services. Consequently, biomedical image segmentation has emerged as a major area of research within computer vision. The progress in deep learning has resulted in the creation of various manually engineered methods, yielding impressive outcomes and establishing new benchmarks in the field. However, a significant difficulty in effectively implementing these algorithms is the selection of suitable hyperparameters. In this research, we tackled this issue by using four meta-heuristic algorithms: Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), Particle Swarm Optimizer (PSO), Bayesian Optimizer (BO) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). By employing these techniques, we automated the optimal hyperparameter selection process, thereby improving image segmentation performance. Our experiments were conducted using Diabetic Retinopathy datasets (AMDs), which comprised 908 training samples and 228 testing samples. The comparative analysis demonstrated that the proposed U-Net-PSO method, which has 276,276 trainable parameters, outperformed the traditional U-Net model, which has 1 million trainable parameters. The accuracy levels achieved by our method were 96.4%, compared to just 75.1% for the traditional U-Net, despite having significantly fewer trainable parameters

articleTitle: Advanced Approaches of the JAYA Algorithm for Single Diode Model Parameter Optimization: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The accurate extraction of parameters from photovoltaic (PV) cells and modules is essential for optimizing solar system performance and maximizing energy efficiency. This study evaluates the performance, stability, and robustness of three well-cited JAYA algorithm variants: DWJAYA, PGJAYA, and LCJAYA. The comparative analysis is based on root mean square error (RMSE) and a non-parametric statistical study. The results indicate that DWJAYA achieves the lowest RMSE of 9.860219 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> with minimal standard deviation (4.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−17</sup>), demonstrating remarkable precision and stability. In contrast, LCJAYA exhibits a higher RMSE variability, with values ranging from 9.860220 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> to 3.242582 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, and PGJAYA shows slight variations but remains close to DWJAYA. Furthermore, a non-parametric statistical analysis confirms the superiority of DWJAYA, as it significantly outperforms both LCJAYA and PGJAYA (p-value 1.73 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>). These findings establish DWJAYA as a robust and reliable alternative for PV parameter extraction, offering enhanced accuracy, stability, and resilience to variations in initial conditions. This work underscores the potential of DWJAYA as an advanced optimization tool for photovoltaic system modeling, contributing to improved renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: Explainable Aircraft Crash Severity Prediction Using XGBoost and SHAP
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Aircraft crash prediction, as a major research topic, focuses on improving aeronautical safety and minimizing fatalities. This study aims to improve the prediction of accident severity by integrating Explainable AI (XAI) with Machine Learning (ML). We use several different types of ML model, including XGBoost, Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and AdaBoost, to model aviation accidents to predict the crash based on a set of characteristics. XGBoost shows higher accuracy than the other models studied. We also employ SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to enhance explainability by locating the most important features that impact the predictions. To analyze the correlations among the attributes and to detect possible redundancies, a correlation matrix is used. Thus, the computational efficiency of XGBoost is assessed, demonstrating its competency. We cross-validate robustness and perform paired t-tests to confirm the statistical significance of the observed performance variations. Additionally, we validated XGBoost using a second dataset to further confirm its reliability and generalization capability across different data distributions. The results of this study point out the need to combine advanced ML tools with XAI in key safety applications.

articleTitle: Enhanced Adaptive Field-Weakening Control for High-Speed Induction Machines Using Stator Voltage Regulation and Nonlinear Magnetizing Inductance Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a novel field-weakening control strategy for induction machines (IMs), emphasizing the development and implementation of proportional-integral (PI) controllers tailored for high-speed operations. By dynamically adjusting the flux using measured stator voltage, the proposed method eliminates the need for rotor flux estimation, thereby improving resilience to parameter variations. A structured design approach ensures precise regulation of flux and torque currents while adhering to voltage and current limitations, enabling stable and efficient performance at elevated speeds. Simulation outcomes confirm the superiority of this approach over the traditional "1/ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>" method, showcasing its ability to sustain steady-state operation at 300% of the rated speed. Key advantages include enhanced torque smoothness, reduced current consumption, and optimized utilization of the DC bus voltage. This study underscores the effectiveness of the PI controller design and the robustness of the proposed technique, demonstrating its suitability for high-speed IM applications in field-weakening scenarios.

articleTitle: Fostering AI Synergy in the Workplace: The Mediating Role of Indonesian Employees Well-Being in Authentic Leadership and AI Experience
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The present study explores into the relationships between authentic leadership, employee well-being, and AI experience among white-collar workers in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia. The study employs a cross-sectional survey and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to reveal that authentic leadership significantly enhances employee well-being, subsequently leading to positive interactions between employees and AI systems. The relationship between authentic leadership and AI experience is partially mediated by employee well-being, demonstrating the significance of leadership qualities like transparency, integrity, and self-awareness in creating a supportive organizational culture. The findings highlight the importance of initiatives focused on employees, such as mental health support and work-life balance, in facilitating AI adoption. However, the study also highlights certain limitations, including geographic and methodological constraints. Future investigations should broaden their scope to encompass various contexts, utilize longitudinal methodologies, and integrate supplementary elements such as technological infrastructure and user perspectives to enhance comprehension. These insights contribute to the growing discourse on leadership, well-being, and technology integration in modern workplaces.

articleTitle: Digital Payment: The Antecedents of QRIS Usage among Gen Z
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The use of QRIS digital payments in Indonesia has increased significantly every year. Bank Indonesia noted that the majority of QRIS users in Jakarta are Generation Z. However, there is still a lack of in-depth explanation of the factors that influence the increase in QRIS use. This study aims to analyze the factors that influence the actual use of QRIS through behavioral intention to use in generation Z in Jakarta. The research method used is a quantitative research type with an associative approach through the distribution of online questionnaires using a Likert scale to 210 respondents in Jakarta. The results of the data obtained were analyzed using PLS-SEM techniques with SmartPLS software. The results of this study indicate that Perceived Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Security have a significant effect on Behavioral Intention. While Social Influence and Hedonic Motivation do not have a significant effect on Behavioral Intention. Then Behavioral Intention has a significant positive effect on Actual Use of QRIS. The implications of this study provide insightful results and can optimize strategies on the benefits, ease of use, and security standards that can encourage user trust to continue using QRIS and increase the interest of new users.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Outlier Detection Algorithms in Agricultural IoT Datasets
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper evaluates the efficiency of eleven outlier detection algorithms applied to three agricultural IoT datasets: Weather in Szeged, Greenhouse, and Crop Recommendation. It focuses on how data quality affects IoT systems' reliability in agriculture. The analyzed algorithms include statistical, distance-based, density-based, ensemble, and hybrid methods, and their ability to detect outliers is investigated using recall, precision, and F1-score. The results demonstrate that algorithm performance is influenced by dataset characteristics such as dimensionality, nonlinearity, and temporal dependencies. Isolation Forest (iForest) consistently outperformed other algorithms due to its non-parametric design and recursive partitioning. In contrast, algorithms like Cluster-Based Local Outlier Factor (CBLOF), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) showed variable effectiveness depending on dataset features. The study emphasizes the need for selecting the appropriate outlier detection method tailored to specific agricultural datasets and recommends future research on hybrid models or deep learning approaches to enhance anomaly detection in agricultural IoT systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of FDM-Printed Gears: A Bayesian Learning Approach to Quality and Weight Reduction
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study presents a data-driven framework for optimizing Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) process parameters using Bayesian Optimization (BO) to enhance the mechanical and surface properties of 3D-printed gears. Five critical parameters—layer height, nozzle temperature, print speed, infill density, and cooling rate—are systematically explored through a Box-Behnken Design (BBD) of experiments, generating 45 parameter combinations. ANSYS simulations are employed to evaluate responses, including surface roughness, weight, and tensile strength, while a Gaussian Process (GP) surrogate model captures the complex relationships between inputs and outputs. A multi-objective cost function prioritizes minimizing roughness and weight while maximizing tensile strength. Bayesian Optimization iteratively refines parameter selection, balancing exploration and exploitation to converge on optimal settings. This work demonstrates the efficacy of integrating computational modeling and machine learning for efficient process optimization in additive manufacturing, offering practical insights for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Artificial Intelligence in the Development of a New AC Resistor Calibration Bridge at the National Metrology Laboratory of Morocco LPEE-LNM
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Electrical reactive components, such as resistors, capacitors, and inductors, play a pivotal role in industries like automotive, aerospace, and electronics. Accurate calibration of these components, particularly AC resistors, is critical for ensuring precise measurements and reliable operations in these sectors. The National Metrology Laboratory of Morocco (LPEE-LNM) excels in DC resistance calibration, addressing the needs of the Moroccan industry. However, its current capabilities in AC resistance calibration are insufficient, leading to reliance on international metrology institutes for primary calibrations. This highlights an urgent need for developing advanced AC calibration methods at LPEE-LNM to meet increasing industrial demands.As a review article, this work explores the current state of the art in AC resistance calibration, both in Africa and internationally. It presents the main calibration techniques and practices implemented by national metrology institutes. Beyond this overview, the article outlines a forward-looking perspective on the integration of artificial intelligence in calibration processes in general, highlighting its potential to support automation and enhance accuracy. It also introduces a development perspective for a new AC resistance calibration bridge at the Moroccan National Metrology Laboratory (LPEE-LNM), aiming to position the institute as a continental leader in this domain.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Solar Stills: A Bibliometric Analysis of Trends, Applications, and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Solar stills are relatively affordable, renewable energy distillers with low maintenance, which can help solve water problems in remote areas. Artificial intelligence (AI) has enhanced efficiency through adaptive control, the adjustment of operational parameters, and the development of forecasting methods and tools. AI solutions, such as hybrid models and machine learning, enhance design, automate tasks, and reduce costs by optimizing insulation and tilt angle, among other factors. There are also additional complementary technologies, such as nanotechnology and phase change materials, that improve sustainability and performance. In this paper, we review the adoption of artificial intelligence technology in solar still research, utilizing a bibliometric technique to analyze 2216 articles published between 2019 and 2024. The results show that the development of AI-integrated solar still technology experienced significant growth between 2019 and 2024, demonstrating how artificial intelligence enhances the efficiency, design, and performance of solar desalination systems. The findings also reveal that The Journal of Cleaner Production and Desalination are the most prominent sources in this field, driving knowledge dissemination and innovation. Additionally, the results highlight that China, India, and Egypt are the most active contributors to this research domain, reflecting their strong commitment to tackling water scarcity and promoting sustainable desalination.

articleTitle: Immersive Exhibition Design: Enhancing the Cultural Heritage of Borobudur and Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This research explores the potential of immersive exhibitions to elevate the cultural heritage of Borobudur in Indonesia and Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan in Thailand. Through case studies of immersive exhibitions and a comprehensive literature review, it aims to develop concepts for visual and installation design. By merging real and virtual environments, the study employs qualitative methods, analyzing audio and video materials from teamLab-Planets immersive exhibitions. Visual mockups were created using available assets and an AI generator to delve into the cultural heritage of Indonesia and Thailand. The installation design draws inspiration from the visual forms of Borobudur and Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan, including temples, stupas, and Buddha statues. To validate the conceptual installation design, bibliometric analysis was conducted, aligning it with current research trends and identifying essential elements for innovation. The research results include an Immersive Design Visualization and a conceptual framework for immersive exhibitions of these iconic sites. The mockup concepts and installation designs will proceed to an experimental design phase, with the ultimate goal of creating a fully realized immersive exhibition.

articleTitle: Cheating Detection in Online Exams Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This has never been truer, especially with the fast growth of online education due to the pandemic around COVID19, posing a challenge for the electronic examinations‘ integrity for educational organizations. To this end, novel solutions leveraging state of the art deep learning techniques, including transfer learning models, have been launched recently. This study proposes to deploy a transfer learning framework to identify and classify cheating attempts in virtual assessments. This model analyzes candidates’ behavior and movement in real-time, as well as detecting unauthorized individuals in proximity, attempts to access mobile devices and potential aids for cheating, such as written notes. The base architecture is built off of MobileNetV2 trained on a dataset we call OEP, which we generated by screenshotting videos. Experimental results yield detection accuracy of 98.30%, superior to prior state-of-the-art models. Moreover, an ablation study based on the use of various pretrained models including InceptionV3, VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet50 and AlexNet was performed to validate the performance of our approach. Below are the results of the evaluation, which highlight the accomplishments of our model in accurately identifying cheating during online tests, and prevent it before they happen.

articleTitle: FEX-IDS: A Federated Learning-Based Explainable Intrusion Detection System for IoT Security
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: With the increasing adoption of the Internet of Things (IoT), ensuring data privacy has become a critical challenge. Traditional Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) often require centralized data collection, raising concerns about sensitive information exposure and potential security breaches. Additionally, the black-box nature of many machine learning-based IDS solutions makes it difficult to understand and trust their decisions. To enhance security in IoT environments, there is a pressing need for a privacy-preserving detection mechanism that not only protects data but also provides transparency into model predictions.This study proposes a Federated & Explainable Intrusion Detection System (FEX-IDS) using Federated Learning (FL) to collaboratively train a model across IoT devices without sharing the raw data which ensure privacy. It evaluates the system on the UNSW-NB15 dataset to over 96% accuracy in binary classification and 86% in multi-classification scenarios. SHAP and LIME are added to provide insights into the model predictions, hence making the model more transparent.

articleTitle: Developing a Real-Time Atmospheric Pollutant Monitoring Method with High Accuracy and Wide Measurement Range
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Air quality is important for the well-being of urban populations. However, the degradation of this quality is a major problem worldwide, caused by rapid urbanization, population growth, increased industrial activities and road traffic. This leads to emissions of fine particles (PM2.5 and PM10), toxic gases as nitrogen dioxide (NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and ozone (O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>), as well as other pollutants that seriously affect public health, the environment and the climate. Addressing these challenges, the development of efficient air pollution monitoring systems has become essential. This paper focuses on the deployment of a method to monitor air pollutants in real time, one based on low-cost sensors and mathematical methods to correct measurement errors, in order to support the accuracy and amplitude of measurements to have a reliable assessment of air quality. The former allows easy access and a large amount of data, while the latter, such as machine learning, are adopted to normalize the data continuously and in real time to compensate for the reading system. To this extent, the procedures explained above guarantee reliable and easy monitoring of pollution levels, providing important information for public health and environmental management.

articleTitle: Image-Based Approach for Android Malware Detection Using APK Component Fusion and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The increase of Android malware, coupled with the growing sophistication of obfuscation techniques, underscores the critical need for advanced detection mechanisms. An innovative method is introdcued that converts essential APK components—namely, classes.dex (Dalvik executable), AndroidManifest.xml (manifest and configuration files), and resources.arsc (compiled resources)—into grayscale images. Incremental feature fusion is then applied to integrate both individual and combined components, allowing a comprehensive assessment of their impact on detection performance. The CICMalDroid 2020 dataset was employed to evaluate multiple convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, with ResNet50 achieving the best results. The model attained an accuracy of 98.83%, a precision of 99.27%, and a recall of 99.15%, demonstrating the effectiveness of feature integration and deep learning techniques in overcoming obfuscation challenges and offering a robust solution for real-world Android malware detection systems.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Financial Services: Applications, Challenges, and Research Directions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the financial sector by enhancing customer experiences and optimizing core processes such as credit evaluation, risk management, and investment guidance. This paper explores how AI reshapes financial markets, addressing its applications, challenges, and future trends, while ensuring regulatory compliance in key areas such as consumer protection, market integrity, and financial stability. To achieve this, the article adopts a comprehensive review methodology, analyzing existing literature on AI's use in finance, including case studies on fraud detection, asset price forecasting, and automated investment services. The research also explores recent innovations in machine learning and their integration into traditional financial models. The findings reveal significant advancements in AI-driven solutions that contribute to more efficient decision-making processes, improved customer engagement, and enhanced risk management strategies. However, the need for equitable AI applications remains a critical concern. In conclusion, this paper highlights the current impact of AI on financial services and the anticipated developments in the near future. It underscores the importance of balancing technological innovation with fairness and inclusivity to ensure AI's sustainable growth in finance.

articleTitle: Validation of the Coping Strategies Scale Among Moroccan Teachers: Psychometric Properties and Structural Equation Modeling (PLS)
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: this study aims to validate a coping strategies scale adapted to Moroccan teachers, assessing its reliability and construct validity within the local educational context. Reliability assessment and dimensional structure analysis compared the instrument with its original version, while structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) analyzed both measurement and structural models, confirming the model's validity and strong fit.The validated scale for the Moroccan context includes four subscales aligned with the theoretical framework: coping strategies addressing curriculum-related challenges, managing student indiscipline, overcoming the lack of teaching resources, and seeking social support. Conceptual validity underwent rigorous adaptation to ensure cultural and contextual relevance.A sample of 218 teachers aged 22 to 61 years, employed in public schools in the Safi region of Morocco, participated in the study. Cronbach’s alpha coefficients indicated satisfactory internal consistency, while the global model presented excellent fit indices, achieving a GoF value of 0.831.These results confirm that the Moroccan version of the coping strategies scale provides a reliable and valid tool for assessing coping strategies in this context.

articleTitle: Robust Stability Analysis of Uncertain 2-D Discrete Systems with Time-Varying Delays and Generalized Overflow Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study introduces an enhanced stability criterion for uncertain two-dimensional (2-D) discrete systems modeled under the Roesser framework, incorporating time-varying delays and generalized overflow arithmetic. The proposed method addresses systems with norm-bounded parametric uncertainties. By constructing an augmented Lyapunov functional, a delay-dependent stability condition is formulated using linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), yielding reduced conservatism compared to existing approaches. A numerical case study validates the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed criterion.

articleTitle: Harnessing AI and Honeybee Sustainable Leadership to Cultivate Financial Literacy and Workplace Happiness in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The impact of artificial intelligence experience and Honeybee Sustainable Leadership (HSL) on financial literacy and workplace happiness among Indonesian employees is examined in the present study. The study uses structural equation modeling to investigate how workplace happiness and HSL influence AI experience and, hence, financial literacy using a sample of 512 Greater Jakarta employees. Results show significant positive correlations: happy companies inspire AI participation, hence promoting employee adaptability and competent use of AI tools. HSL, which stands for ethical openness, trust, and teamwork, improves the artificial intelligence experience even more and advances an innovative culture. The paper also emphasizes how artificial intelligence (AI) tools empower workers in financial decision-making by offering real-time insights and simplifying difficult financial ideas, hence raising financial literacy. The mediation power of artificial intelligence experience emphasizes its relevance in connecting financial competency and occupational dynamics. These results imply that companies should stress ethical leadership and encourage work conditions to maximize artificial intelligence's possibilities, promoting both financial literacy and workplace satisfaction. To further knowledge of AI's influence on employee well-being and financial competency, constraints including sampling techniques and self-reported data demand additional study with varied samples, longitudinal designs, and comparisons with other leadership styles.

articleTitle: Smart Materials Unveiled: From Fundamentals to AI-Driven Innovations
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The development of intelligent or smart materials is crucial to meet the demand for modern materials and to solve issues related to durability, performance, cost, resource availability, and environmental impact. Due to their great potential, they can be employed in many different sectors, such as biomedical, automotive, aerospace, civil industries, and energy. These materials are diverse, including piezoelectric materials, shape-memory alloys, magnetostrictive materials, electro- and magnetorheological fluids, chromic materials, and self-healing materials. In this paper, various kinds of intelligent materials are discussed, along with their benefits, limitations, potential uses, and the important role artificial intelligence has played in the progress of smart material research.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control for Grid-Connected PMSG Wind Turbines: Modeling, Simulation, and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents the modeling, simulation, and control of a wind energy conversion system (WECS) based on a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM). The focus is on implementing an advanced control strategy for both the machine-side and grid-side components to optimize system performance. Sliding Mode Control (SMC) has been evaluated for its capability in regulating rotor speed, electromagnetic torque, and grid current under varying wind and load conditions. The machine-side control ensures maximum power extraction by tracking the optimal tip-speed ratio, while the grid-side control maintains a stable DC-link voltage, minimizes harmonic distortion, and ensures compliance with grid standards. MATLAB/Simulink is employed to simulate the system and analyze the performance of the control techniques. The results demonstrate the superior stability, efficiency, and reliability of the proposed control strategy, highlighting its suitability for renewable energy applications such as wind turbines. This study contributes to advancing wind energy technology by providing insights into the performance of the sliding mode control method and its potential to enhance energy conversion efficiency and grid integration.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Atrial Fibrillation Detection: A Systematic Review of Recent Advances in ECG-Based Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Atrial fibrillation is one of the most prevalent types of cardiac arrhythmias and has strong connections to stroke and heart failure. Its early detection is often hindered by variability in EGC signals, especially in cases of paroxysmal AF. The development of AI has recently removed some stubborn barriers to AF detection through the application of deep learning techniques. This paper systematically reviews 12 current studies published between 2023 and 2024 that employed AI models for AF detection with varying ECG modalities, including single-lead, 12-lead, and image-based ECG. The paper is organized by the data types present in the studies, the preprocessing of these data, the AI architectures used, and validation protocols in use within the clinical setup. Our findings indicate that attention-based networks, hierarchical models, and features extraction techniques, such as chirplet transforms, have effectively improved the detection accuracy of AF. In addition, we look at the role of wearable and mobile technologies regarding ECG by comparing smart device-based AI algorithms with traditional ones used in diagnostic practice. Also discussed will be challenges such as dataset imbalance, signal noise from wearable devices, interpretable AI models, and cross-platform validation. The paper summarizes with future directions of AI in improving diagnostic inclusion, toward transparency, and embedding these technologies into everyday clinical practice.

articleTitle: THz SISO and MIMO antennas for THz, challenges and applications: Review
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: the emergence of new technologies is accelerating the communication era’s evolution, catering to the needs of higher data rates, lower latency, and enhanced spectral efficiency. The terahertz (THz) band spinning from 0.1 to 10 THz has identified as an attractive option for 6G and beyond, enabling ultra-broadband capacity to enable next-generation applications. However, a detailed analysis demonstrate that using THz waves in wireless communication creates new issues that require thoughtful consideration. Within the range of terahertz (THz) wireless communication, the primary limitations occurs due to air attenuation largely caused by water vapor absorption. This paper presents the terahertz band characteristics in wireless communication and overviews the technologies enabling THz communication and overcoming the limitations faced in the development and deployment of THz antennas, among these technologies Single Input Single Output is employed which is distinguished by its simplicity and low system complexity. Furthermore, Multiple Input Multiple Output offers significant potential for unlocking the capabilities of THz frequency range more effective beamforming, enhanced dependability, and spatial multiplexing. The concluding section of this paper, explore the importance of integrating the AI in THz wireless communication, using machine learning algorithms to enhance the antenna design parameters and tackling challenges related to channel estimation, beamforming, spectrum management, error correction, and hardware optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of E-WOM Credibility on Tiktok Social Media and Its Influence on Brand Image and Online Purchase Intention of Local Fiber Products at Tiktok Shop
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of e-WOM (electronic word-of-mouth) Credibility in TikTok social media and its impact on customer purchase intentions at TikTok Shop. E-WOM Credibility is measured through Homophly, Trust, Recommendation, and Message Content. The influence of e-WOM Credibility can also be influenced by Brand Image which will also affect Online Purchase Intention. Therefore, this study will discuss the effect of e-WOM Credibility in TikTok social media on Online Purchase Intention at TikTok Shop. This research will use a quantitative approach with a purposive sampling method. The research sample will be taken from TikTok Shop customers who have purchased local fiber products as many as 210 respondents at TikTok Shop due to the influence of e-WOM on TikTok social media. The results of this study found that Homophily, Trust, Recommendation, and Message Content are proven to shape the occurrence of e-WOM Credibility on TikTok social media. And simultaneously, the existence of e-WOM Credibility also affects the Brand Image of the product which then affects consumer purchase intention. The results of this study are expected to provide a better understanding of the effect of e-WOM Credibility in TikTok social media on Online Purchase Intention at TikTok Shop. In addition, the results of this study can also provide recommendations for TikTok Shop to improve the credibility of e-WOM on TikTok social media.

articleTitle: Siamese GRU for Arabic-English Cross-language Plagiarism Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Plagiarism is a significant issue in academic and research fields, posing challenges to the integrity of scholarly work. With the increasing availability of multilingual resources, cross-language plagiarism has become a growing concern, where content is translated from one language to another to avoid detection. Detecting cross-language plagiarism is particularly challenging when it involves the Arabic language, given its rich morphology and complex syntax. This study proposes a novel approach for detecting cross-language plagiarism targeting the English-Arabic language pair. The methodology includes the pre-trained XLM-Roberta transformer combined with a Siamese Gated Recurrent Unit (SGRU) architecture, applied on the OPUS dataset, specifically utilizing data from Wikipedia. The experimental results demonstrate that this combination outperforms the state-of-the-art, achieving an accuracy of 95.52%, a precision of 94.93%, a recall of 96.13%, and an F1-score of 95.52%.

articleTitle: Forced Convection Heat Transfer via Horizontal and Vertical Pipes Elbow-Shaped at Constant Heat Flux: A Numerical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the present work, a numerical investigation has been executed for airflow behavior and heat transfer in steady state for three-dimensional flow through horizontal and vertical pipes with an elbow. The primary aim of this research is to identify the effect of six different velocities of air adopted (1.5 m/s, 2 m/s, 2.5 m/s, 3 m/s, 3.5 m/s, and 4 m/s) as inlet boundary condition on the thermal performance along pipes length. Airflow through steel pipe exposed to constant heat flux (1655.6 W/m2). Airflow is investigated by evaluating the distributions of velocity and pressure, whereas the thermal aspect is assessed through the analysis of the Nusselt number. The Finite Volume Method acted as the solver for the governing equations in a three-dimensional model. The study model's geometries and meshes were first created in ANSYS Workbench, followed by the execution of the relevant simulations using the FLUENT code. The results indicated that the increment temperature at pipe curvature for all velocity inlet values because local velocity is reduced in this region. At low air velocity inlet, temperature difference between wall pipe and fluid becomes high then a low average Nusselt number appears. However, at higher velocity of inlet, it becomes low and as a result Nusselt number increases. In addition, at elbow curvature had a considerable effect on the air velocity, the velocity value at the outer elbow side was higher than at the inner elbow side. These changes in velocity profile happen due to stagnation region that emerges on the inner side. The air pressure elevated at the entrance area and then decreased as it approached the pipe's exit owing to the fully developed fluid velocity and the outflow boundary condition.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Education in Morocco: A Conceptual Framework for an ePortfolio System
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study proposes a conceptual ePortfolio system designed to enhance the learning outcomes of final-year medical students in Morocco. Grounded in a constructivist approach and leveraging the potential of Web 3.0 technologies, the framework aims to address the critical need for a dynamic and innovative approach to documenting, processing, and leveraging clinical experiences. By bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, the framework promotes reflective practice, enhances feedback and collaboration, and equips students for a seamless transition into independent medical practice. This approach highlights the transformative potential of ePortfolios in shaping competent, reflective, and adaptable healthcare professionals.

articleTitle: AI and Workplace Happiness: A Symbiotic Relationship Driving Indonesian Employees’ Engagement
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study explores the relationship between workplace happiness, AI usage, and AI-based engagement, with a particular focus on the mediating role of AI usage. It examines how a positive work environment influences AI adoption and how AI tools, in turn, enhance employee engagement with these technologies. A quantitative cross-sectional survey was conducted among white-collar employees in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia, using purposive sampling. Structural equation modeling (SEM) was employed to test the hypothesized relationships. The results demonstrate that workplace happiness significantly influences AI usage, which then positively affects AI engagement. The mediation analysis reveals that AI usage plays a crucial role in linking workplace happiness to enhanced AI engagement, underscoring the importance of cultivating a positive work environment to foster both AI usage and engagement. However, the study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which limits causal inferences, and the focus on white-collar workers in Greater Jakarta, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. Future research should explore longitudinal studies and consider broader populations as well as additional variables influencing AI usage. Organizations can apply these findings to improve employee engagement with AI by promoting a supportive, happy work environment and investing in employee well-being and AI training. This study contributes to the literature by highlighting the mediating role of AI usage, an aspect that has been underexplored.

articleTitle: A Smart Logistics Architecture Using IoT and Hashgraph
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Over the last decades, the industrial sector has known significant technological progress, that led to major improvements in logistics. This evolution has given rise to the concept of ’Smart Logistics’, which refers to the integration of advanced technologies such as Internet of things (IoT), DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology)... in logistic. Hashgraph [1] is a trusted digital innovation technology, as a type of DLT, it is recognized by its characteristics of sustainability, rapidity, and low cost... , IoT devices play a crucial role in enabling real-time monitoring of the logistics environment... The combination of these two technologies not only enhances overall performance but also addresses the security vulnerabilities inherent in IoT. This paper highlights the contribution of IoT and Hashgraph technology for the benefit of future logistics and presents an architecture for low-cost and echo-friendly logistics systems based on IoT-enabled Hashgraph technology. The evaluation results show that our proposed solution effectively solves logistics system challenges related to performance, and sustainability. Moreover, its low cost, efficiency and minimal energy consumption make it a recommended choice for both small and big-sized logistics companies and stakeholders.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection System For Internet of Medical Things Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) is transforming healthcare by increasing accuracy, reliability, and scalability through smart, connected medical devices that enable real-time monitoring and accurate diagnosis. However, due to their resource limitations and diverse features, IoMT networks face significant privacy and security challenges, including vulnerabilities to cyber threats such as man-in-the-middle, DoS, remote hijacking, and replay. The healthcare ecosystem faces critical risks from IoMT vulnerabilities, threatening human lives and system integrity. To address evolving cyber-attacks, intrusion detection systems (IDS) have become essential, with machine learning (ML) techniques proving highly effective. This study presents a low-cost, high-accuracy ML-based attack detection framework for securing IoMT devices. Eight ML models, including Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Gradient Boosting, K-Nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were evaluated on the IoT-Healthcare security dataset. XGBoost emerged as the top performer, achieving 99.98% accuracy in just 233 ms.

articleTitle: Hybrid Wind-Diesel Energy System with Energy Storage for Remote Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Off-grid electrical loads are generally powered by diesel generators and despite their flexibility and high power to weight ratio as their advantages; their high cost of operation and CO2 emissions raise the need for better alternatives such as renewable energy sources. Fluctuation of wind speeds is the main limiting factor in considering pure wind energy systems in remote areas. For off-grid applications, a hybrid energy system combines many energy sources to deliver steady and dependable power. Such systems' optimal operation depends on the climatic characteristics of the geographical location and other design parameters such as general system configuration, system components sizing, and fuel price fluctuation. Therefore, the study seeks to design and develop different hybrid wind-diesel energy system configurations for off-grid applications using the HOMER software to determine an optimal model. Three scenarios are investigated in this study: Traditional Diesel Generator; Wind-diesel Hybrid System; and Wind-diesel-battery System. The economic and reliability analysis of the system and the total CO2 emissions as compared for all scenarios. The main objective of the study is to identify an optimal configuration with minimum investment, low usage of diesel generators, to meet the load requirements and reliability of a Hybrid Wind- Diesel Energy System.

articleTitle: Exploring Privacy as a Success Factor in Information Systems Projects: a Position Paper
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The privacy of data subjects processed in information systems has been the focus of concerns, debates, and regulations in the international context. However, there is a gap between scientific research in this area and its implementation in projects. This paper contextualizes success management and data protection practices. Despite the evolution of legislation applied to privacy, information systems project managers still fail to address this issue. Concerns about the privacy of data subjects should be a success factor in the management of information systems projects.

articleTitle: Pharma 4.0 Implementation Challenges and Potential Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Pharma 4.0 utilizes emerging Industry 4.0 technologies to improve production efficiency, quality management, and supply chain operations. However, its adoption faces significant challenges which are compounded by stringent regulations. This review aims to identify these challenges and propose solutions based on existing literature. Using a systematic literature review methodology, studies published between 2014 and 2024 in Scopus and Web of Science databases were analyzed. The findings reveal the main challenges across production and maintenance, quality management, supply chain management, and workforce readiness. To address the identified challenges, scalable and modular frameworks were identified. These frameworks offer a practical pathway for organizations to adopt Pharma 4.0 incrementally while addressing the challenges. Additionally, these frameworks enable gradual integration of advanced technologies, improving traceability and compliance, supply chain transparency as well as establishing the required workforce competencies. Thus, this review provides valuable insights for industry experts, policymakers, and scholars by offering them strategies to effectively navigate the challenges of Pharma 4.0 implementation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Agents in Smart Logistics and Warehouse Automation: Overview
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The rise of intelligent agents has triggered an avalanche of innovation in smart logistics and warehouse automation, changing the way supply chain operations are managed forever. This review focuses on the basic principles of AI and intelligent agents applied to logistics and also describes some real-world applications. It contemplates its defining characteristics, including autonomous, adaptive, and collaborative, in line with technologies such as automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), Autonomous Mobile Robots(AMRs), Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and the Internet of Things (IoT). The study has also identified that multi-agent systems have a very relevant role in streamlining and optimizing the most complex processes in logistics, apart from the operational and strategic benefits accruable from better efficiency, cost reduction, and improved decision-making. In Conclusion, The extant literature highlights how intelligent agents may influence the realms of operational efficiency and decision-making within logistics. Nevertheless, further commitment is still needed toward understanding the practical feasibility of the agents and implications concerning workforce dynamics and operational practices. The contribution will be an overview of the current scenario and future possibilities for intelligent agents in reshaping smart logistics and warehouse automation.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Advanced Control Strategies of Adaptive Cruise Control System in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) represent a highly promising solution for our environment by reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Furthermore, they offer the potential to decrease accident rates through ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems). These systems enhance driver comfort, ensure safety, and optimize the range of electric vehicles by utilizing adaptive cruise control (ACC) systems. Speed regulation in EVs relies on a dual-loop architecture: the first loop, controlled by the ACC, generates a speed reference based on the current speed and calculated distance, while the second loop adjusts the speed of the electric motor to ensure smooth and optimal driving. This article provides an in-depth review of research into control techniques applied to ACC systems in electric vehicles. It analyzes conventional and advanced approaches, highlighting their advantages and limitations. Finally, it identifies the main challenges ahead and suggests avenues of research for the future development of these technologies.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Multimodal Techniques for Neurodegenerative Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s, represent a significant global health burden due to their progressive nature and lack of curative treatments. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical but remains a challenge due to the limitations of single-modality diagnostic tools. Recent advances in neuroimaging, genetic, and clinical data on these multimodal approaches have provided promising solutions by leveraging the complementary information from diverse biomarkers. This review revisits the state-of-the-art neurodegenerative disease-detection multimodal methods with regards to novel data fusion techniques, deep learning frameworks, and explainable AI applications. Key case studies and datasets are discussed that illustrate the impact of such methods in early diagnosis, cognitive monitoring, and the prediction of response to therapeutic intervention. Emerging trends to receive attention in this review include the incorporation of real-world data, and temporal biomarker analysis. Current challenges are addressed and future directions explored to further precision medicine in neurodegenerative disease diagnosis and management.

articleTitle: Towards Safer and Smarter Integration of Conflict Management Algorithms: A Quantitative and Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) face significant challenges in overtaking maneuvers, where balancing safety, efficiency, and adaptability is crucial. This paper provides a quantitative and comparative analysis of conflict management algorithms, including Reinforcement Learning (RL), Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Game Theory, assessing their strengths and limitations in handling decision-making under uncertainty. Through bibliometric evaluation and performance assessment, we highlight gaps in existing methods and propose a hybrid approach that integrates multiple decision-making paradigms to enhance robustness, adaptability, and real-time responsiveness. This study lays the groundwork for more intelligent and reliable overtaking strategies, addressing a critical aspect of AV decision-making.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity: Applications, Challenges, and Future Developments
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Cybersecurity is facing increasingly sophisticated threats, such as ransomware, complex DDoS attacks, and zero-day attacks. These evolving threats reveal the limitations of traditional detection, prevention, and response methods. In this context, the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) emerges as a promising solution. Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms enable enhanced detection of malicious behaviors, real-time anomaly identification, and the anticipation of cyberattacks before they cause significant damage. However, the adoption of AI in cybersecurity introduces new challenges, such as adversarial attacks targeting AI models, the lack of transparency in algorithmic decision-making, and the dependence on data quality. This document reviews the current applications of AI in cybersecurity, highlighting its contributions, limitations, and future perspectives. It also explores emerging solutions to counter zero-day attacks, the development of human-AI collaborative systems for adaptive defense, and the establishment of ethical and regulatory frameworks to ensure the responsible use of AI, aimed at protecting critical systems in the long term against increasingly sophisticated threats.

articleTitle: Unveiling Health’s Tomorrow: A Comprehensive Review of Anomaly Detection for IoMT Using Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This systematic literature review provides a thorough examination of the utilization of Large Language Models (LLMs) in predictive analysis and anomaly detection for IoMT networks, focusing on the latest developments in research landscape, and potential future prospects. LLMs have exhibited considerable promise in interpreting and analyzing vast datasets to recognize patterns, anticipate future occurrences, and identify abnormal behavior across diverse domains. Moreover, this review presents a detailed overview of LLM and outlines pivotal trends anticipated to influence the advancement of LLMs in these areas, encompassing the shift towards real-time processing, the significance of adopting sustainable modeling methodologies, and the benefits derived from collaboration across disciplines. In conclusion, this review emphasizes the revolutionary impact of LLMs in IoMT predictive and anomaly identification, highlighting the imperative for ongoing innovation, and practical solutions to fully harness their capabilities.

articleTitle: Improved Stability Criteria for Discrete-Time Switched Systems With Time-Varying Delay Using Relaxed Summation Inequality
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper deals with the stability analysis of discrete-time switched systems with time-varying delay governed by an arbitrary switching law. By constructing a multiple Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and employing a relaxed summation inequality, new sufficient criteria are established and validated to guarantee the asymptotic stability of the studied system. The proposed criteria rely on both the lower and upper bounds of the delay and are formulated as Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs). Moreover, additional slack variables are incorporated to provide more relaxation in the analysis of the system under consideration. As a result, the proposed method is demonstrated to produce less conservative results compared to recent studies in the literature. Some numerical examples are performed to show the advantage and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Supervised and Unsupervised Classification Methods for Sentinel-2 Imagery
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The proposed article aims to apply and compare supervised and unsupervised classification methods on Sentinel-2 imagery, employing the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) to detect the coastline. The study is carried out within a Geographic Information System (GIS) framework, enabling efficient spatial data processing and analysis. The primary objective of the research is to evaluate the effectiveness of two classification methods: Maximum Likelihood Classification (MLC), a supervised method, and K-Means clustering, an unsupervised method. While MLC relies on prior knowledge and training sites to classify image pixels, K-Means automatically groups pixels into clusters without prior training. The first step is to achieve NDWI from the Sentinel-2 dataset, a widely used index for water body detection. This index enhances the contrast between water and land, making it easier to identify water bodies. The extracted NDWI data is then subjected to both MLC and K-Means classification techniques. The results indicate that both classification methods are valid and effective for identifying water bodies using NDWI. However, the K-Means clustering method demonstrated superior performance in terms of accuracy and consistency. This suggests that the unsupervised approach may be more suitable for applications where prior training data is unavailable or limited.

articleTitle: Design A Secure Customize Search Engine Based on Link 's Metadata Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The fast growth of the Internet and the ever-growing size of online data have created significant challenges in providing users with the most relevant and more secure search results. Traditional search engines often struggle to deliver accurate information and are vulnerable to security threats, such as phishing attacks and other online risks. The lack of customized search engines tailored to identify unsecure website in real time without depending on the black list approach calls attention to a significant gap in addressing various user needs and navigating intricate datasets effectively specially to overcome zero-day attack. This paper aim to proposes a Secure Custom Search Engine (SCSE) system to handle these limitations by enhancing the relevance and security of retrieved search results through metadata-driven analysis. The security-checking process examines key metadata features like SSL certificate details, HTTPS usage, WHOIS country, website age, and other relevant indicators to classify links as either suspicious or legitimate. The results show that the system enhances boosts user safety by identifying suspicious links based on metadata analysis.

articleTitle: Tensor Decomposition Techniques for Mixed Radiation Signal Separation: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Accurate discrimination between neutrons and gamma rays in mixed radiation fields is essential for effective neutron detection, which plays a critical role in applications such as homeland security and medical treatments. Various traditional and advanced techniques have been proposed to enhance the performance and precision of neutron-gamma discrimination. This study provides a comparative analysis of three tensor decomposition-based methods—Multiway Blind Source Separation (MBSS), Sequentially Truncated Multilinear Singular Value Decomposition (ST-MLSVD), and Nonnegative Tensor Factorization (NTF)—for addressing this challenge. The results show that MBSS and ST-MLSVD significantly outperform NTF in terms of signal isolation, as indicated by the mean Signal-to-Interference Ratio values. Additionally, all three methods effectively characterized the sources, with correlation coefficient calculations further validating their performance in distinguishing neutron and gamma signals.

Author Keywords: Sequentially truncated multilinear singular value decomposition (ST-MLSVD)

articleTitle: Addressing Supply Chain Uncertainty and Instability Through Industry 4.0 Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The external environment of businesses has grown more unpredictable in recent years, posing more risks in the global supply chain management (SCM). Environmental uncertainty will have greater detrimental repercussions, especially as more companies begin to operate abroad. Implementing Industry 4.0 (I4.0) such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), BlockChain, Internet of Things (IoT), makes it possible for the reduction of uncertainty and instability in the supply chain through the integration of the different technologies. These strategies increase resilience and enable quick, flexible decision-making. This study explores how I4.0 technologies can change supply chains, emphasizing how they can manage uncertainties, lower risks and enhance stability in both the upstream and downstream segments of the logistic chain. In the same direction, this paper offers insights into how businesses might use I4.0 to manage a more complicated and unpredictable global environment by examining existing uses and potential future developments.
