This study used quantitative methods and an online survey of 387 active Instagram users in Indonesia to obtain primary data. The data collected was then analyzed with multivariate statistics and partial least square-structural equation modeling. The results of the analysis prove that all hypotheses are accepted: online supportive interaction, dine-in experience, and self-expression, which positively and significantly affect customer behavior when posting food photos on Instagram. In addition, it has been proven that the dine-in experience positively and significantly affects customer self-expression. This study contributes to the food industry by stimulating consumers to post photos during restaurant dine-in.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to protect critical infrastructures in developing countries: case of Senegalese public services sector
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Over the past decade, developing countries, and Senegal in particular, have been faced with an upsurge in cyber-attacks on their critical infrastructure systems, especially in the public services sector. Given the lack of appropriate cyber defence mechanisms and the central role played by this sector in society, the challenges of protecting it against cyber-attacks, which have become more complex and sophisticated, are bound to multiply. This article proposes a new model for cyber defence of the public services sector in developing countries, particularly Senegal. The approach adopted is based on Deep Learning integrated into Wazuh, an open source SIEM. The proposed system was able to detect and neutralise cyber threats with an average accuracy of 97,40%. The dataset chosen for this study is a LOG dataset made up of log events collected from a KAGGLE dataset database and GitHub repositories.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of PID-PSS and Fuzzy PSS Integrated with SMC for Power Systems SMIB included SMES
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of advanced control strategies to enhance the stability of a Single Machine Infinite Bus (SMIB) system integrated with the Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) device. Two approaches are evaluated: a control strategy based on a Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) based on conventional Power system stabilizer (PSS) and Sliding mode control (SMC), and an approach combining a Fuzzy PSS with SMC. The study highlights the key role of SMES in compensating energy imbalances and improving transient stability. Simulation results show that integrating FPSS significantly enhances oscillation damping and adaptation to system nonlinearities. The PID-PSS-SMC-SMES approach provides better precision and eliminates the error. In contrast, the FPSS-SMC-SMES combination ensures faster stabilization and more effective disturbance damping, thereby strengthening the robustness of the power system SMIB.

articleTitle: Computational Efficiency in Precision Agriculture: MobileNetV2 Outperforms State-of-the-Art CNNs for Real-Time Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This research addresses critical challenges in global agriculture–particularly climate change, soil degradation, and water scarcity–by advancing smart farming technologies. Automated systems powered by computer vision (CV) and deep learning (DL) enable early plant disease detection, delivering faster, more accurate, and more cost-effective solutions than traditional methods. These innovations enhance crop management and food security. We present a comparative analysis of five deep learning architectures (EfficientNetV2, ResNet50, MobileNetV2, Inception-v2, and DenseNet210) for early pathology detection. By employing user-friendly imaging techniques and scalable solutions, this work facilitates widespread farmer adoption. Future efforts will refine these technologies, improve their adaptability across diverse agricultural environments, and integrate them into existing practices to boost productivity, sustainability, and resilience in modern agriculture.

articleTitle: Design of an ultra-fast charging station for EVs
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a high-power fast-charging station for electric vehicles (EVs), addressing the critical need for efficient infrastructure to support rapid EV adoption. Two primary architectures—modular and single-converter structures—are analyzed, with an innovative solution proposed through advanced converter integration to optimize energy management and minimize losses. The developed charging station delivers 500 kW of power with 95% efficiency, enabling a full battery charge (0–100%) within 10–15 minutes. This performance aligns with growing demands for ultra-fast charging, as global EV adoption surpassed 15 million units in 2023, while only 30% of existing charging infrastructure currently supports high-speed capabilities. Simulation results demonstrate enhanced energy efficiency and scalability, positioning the proposed system as a viable advancement for sustainable transport electrification.

articleTitle: Optimizing Flood Hazard Prediction Parameters Using LSTM and GIS: A Case Study of Tetouan City, Morocco
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The problem of climate change negatively affects the world, causing several devastating natural catastrophes among them floods. Their consequences are significant for human lives and materials. Particularly in Morocco frequent and severe floods have taken place in various territories, putting the country it in great need of proactive modeling and management to avoid such a risk. Different methods have been employed for this purpose especially Artificial Intelligent (AT) and Geographic Information Systems (GTS). Therefore, this work aims to enhance the accuracy of deep learning techniques through extensive experimentation and testing of different optimization strategies in Tetouan in the north of Morocco. The dataset includes 11 flood conditioning factors, along with the various optimization techniques to augment the accuracy of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model, such as batch normalization, data augmentation, and Information Gain Ratio (IGR). After the analysis, the results show that the LSTM model achieved a high accuracy of 95.21%.

articleTitle: Overhead Crane Control Under Constraints: A Comparative Study of Linear and Nonlinear Models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study presents a control system for an overhead crane using an NMPC control approach to stabilise the cable angle θ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and payload angle θ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> under state and control input constraints. The control strategy, implemented in a MATLAB/Simulink environment, is designed to minimise oscillations and improve the stability and safety of the crane system. The constraints ensure that the angles and control inputs remain within predefined bounds, addressing practical limitations for real-world applications. Both linear and nonlinear system dynamics were analysed, with the results demonstrating the algorithm's effectiveness in stabilising the crane system in both cases. The nonlinear model captures more realistic dynamics, whereas the linear model achieves faster stabilisation. The proposed approach exhibits robustness and accuracy in maintaining stability under constraints.

articleTitle: The Influence of E-Satisfaction, E-Trust, Perceived Value, and Digital Influencers on Repurchase Intention with Prior Online Experience as a Moderator Variable
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study aims to explore the influence of e-satisfaction, and digital influencers on the intention to repurchase online fashion products. The research approach used is quantitative research, with primary data sources, and using the data collection method is a questionnaire. The sample of this study amounted to 210 customers who had purchased fashion products online and used purposive sampling techniques for sample selection. Data analysis was carried out using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM-PLS). The results of the study show that e-satisfaction and the influence of digital influencers have a significant influence on repurchase intentions. However, factors such as e-trust, perceived value, and previous online experience did not show significant influence. These findings imply that to increase repurchase intent, online fashion product sellers need to increase customer satisfaction levels and leverage digital influencers effectively in their marketing strategies. This research provides new insights into the factors that affect customer loyalty in the context of fashion e-commerce.

articleTitle: Modern Irrigation Systems Adoption in Morocco: Problems and Development Directions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Morocco’s agricultural sector, important to its economy and food security, faces significant challenges due to water scarcity, climate variability, population growth and the inefficiencies of traditional irrigation systems. Despite the potential of modern irrigation technologies to optimize water use and improve crop yields, their adoption in Morocco remains limited due to financial constraints, infrastructure deficits and compatibility issues with traditional practices. This paper examines the current state of irrigation in Morocco and compares it to global practices, highlighting important challenges limited the adoption of modern systems. It provides practical recommendations for Morocco, including new policies, financial support and the development of collaboration among stakeholders for technological integration. The study concludes with a vision for fostering sustainable agricultural in Morocco, emphasizing the critical role of modern irrigation systems to ensure water efficiency and resource conservation in Morocco's arid climate.

articleTitle: Modelling Peatland Fire Risk and Economic Losses in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Indonesian peatlands have a crucial role in mitigating global climate change through acting as carbon sinks and reservoirs. However, because of the frequent and recurrent fires that result in high carbon emissions and substantial financial losses, which can threaten environmental stability, these roles are becoming more and more impaired. This study aims to map the risk of peatland fires across Sumatra and Kalimantan by combining logistic regression and Monte Carlo simulation. Logistic regression is used to estimate the fire probability based on significant factors including water table height, distance to human activities, and vegetation type. Monte Carlo simulation is then used to estimate the potential economic losses caused by these fires. The data are integrated through a gridding approach, which divides the area into grids of 1 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Finally, a thorough risk matrix and a spatially explicit fire risk map are produced, providing policymakers important information for allocating resources and prioritizing mitigation actions. According to the analysis, there are geographical variations in the risk of peatland fires, with the risk being mostly low, low to moderate, and medium to high.

articleTitle: Securing IoT Architectures with Blockchain: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The rapid growth of the Internet of Things creates many challenges for security and scalability. These challenges result from device weaknesses and the complexity of large-scale data management. To shed light on these issues, this paper reviews recent studies from databases like Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore. We selected articles that clearly propose blockchain-based solutions addressing IoT security, trust, traceability, or scalability, while excluding those that do not focus on these aspects. The results reveal key obstacles related to blockchain integration into IoT architectures. These include limited scalability, difficulties with interoperability among different systems, and data privacy risks. The paper also proposes solutions and directions for future research. Examples are improved consensus protocols, simpler cryptographic methods, and common standards. These proposals aim to strengthen security and enhance performance in blockchain-based IoT systems.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Nonsingular based Sliding Mode Lateral Control for Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a fixed-time nonsingular sliding mode control (FTNSMC) for lateral path tracking under external disturbances. Using a quintic equation to define the desired trajectory, the proposed control ensures that the tracking error converges to zero within a fixed and predefined time, regardless of the initial conditions, and achieves this without chattering. The Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization (TLBO) algorithm is employed to tune the control gains, enhancing the overall performance of the controller. System stability is rigorously proven using the Lyapunov approach. Two distinct initial positions, y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1|t=0</inf> = 0.3 and y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2|t=0</inf> = 0.4, were selected, and in both cases, the system achieved convergence within the same fixed time, T=1.51s, which is significantly lower than the calculated maximum allowable time, T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>≈ 9.5s, thereby demonstrating the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Greenhouse Management: A Comparative Analysis of Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Modern agriculture increasingly relies on smart greenhouses to create controlled environments that optimize crop growth. Effective management of these systems requires accurate prediction of key environmental parameters, robust decision-making processes, and a strong focus on enhancing operational efficiency and sustainability. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of two machine learning models, the Random Forest Regressor (RFR) and the Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBR), to predict greenhouse conditions for tomato cultivation and manage critical devices such as heating, lighting and irrigation. The models were assessed based on root mean squared error (RMSE), R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), and other relevant performance metrics.These results demonstrate the robustness and generalization capacity of both models. RFR exhibited slightly better predictive performance for heating and irrigation, while both models achieved near-identical accuracy for lighting. The high precision of both algorithms highlights their potential for real-time greenhouse management.

articleTitle: Industrial Robots and Collaborative Robots: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0 and advancements in artificial intelligence tools, the industry is increasingly moving towards automation and reducing human intervention in production processes. In this context, industrial robots play a crucial role in modern industry, not only enhancing production and improving product quality but also addressing production uncertainties and, most importantly, reducing maintenance and production costs. To this end, the present paper proposes a comparative study of industrial robots and collaborative robots, based on a review of the literature published over the past five years. This analysis revealed that both types of robots share similarities in the nature of the faults encountered. However, the type of applications and their working environments require distinct strategies: early predictive maintenance is necessary for collaborative robots, while preventive maintenance is more suitable for industrial robots. These approaches rely on classification methods such as k-Nearest Neighbors algorithms, Convolutional Neural Networks, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, and other neural networks for fault detection and effective trajectory control. The findings of this study will provide valuable information and serve as a significant resource for future researchers addressing challenges related to the use of these robots.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction in Indonesia Using Machine Learning Techniques for Multiclass Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This research concentrates on utilizing multiclass classification methodology for heart disease prediction. Specifically, this paper explores the utilization of Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers to classify various cardiac conditions. This research is used to get the best results in predicting heart disease that has a classification of more than two categories using machine learning methods. The main goal is to contribute insights to medical diagnostics by explaining the effectiveness of SVM and MLP in improving the accuracy of heart disease prediction models in various classes using several factors that influence heart disease. The data used in this research has missing values, therefore in this research, several methods were used to overcome missing values. Determining the best model is done by comparing precision, recall, and accuracy values. The best model in this research is the SVM model because it has the highest accuracy, precision, and recall. It is hoped that this research can provide knowledge to optimize its application in the identification and classification of heart disease to make it more efficient.

articleTitle: Enhancing DarkWebActivities Classification Using Embedding Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The Dark Web is frequently associated with illegal operations, including drug trafficking, arms dealing, cybercrime, and hacking-related services. Mitigating these threats remains a major challenge for cybersecurity professionals and law enforcement agencies, given the complexity and evolving nature of cybercriminal activities. However, the recent progress in Artificial Intelligence and machine learning has introduced new approaches to analyse the Dark Web content and activities. This study proposes a novel classification approach capable of identifying ten types of illicit activities. The system is built upon the publicly accessible DUTA dataset, which offers a structured corpus for such analysis. To classify the Dark Web activities, ensemble learning algorithms were employed, including Random Forest, Light Gradient Boosting Machine, Extreme Gradient Boosting, Gradient Boosting, and CatBoost. To convert text-based data into numerical vector formats suitable for computational processing, five distinct word embedding techniques were utilized. The results of this study show that the combination of the RoBERTa embedding with the XGB classifier achieved promising results, with a precision of 99.98%. These results underscore the capability of the proposed methodology to detect and categorize illicit Dark Web activities.

articleTitle: The Role of E-Commerce in Sustainable Development for Solo Travel: Insights from International Travelers in Bali
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Solo travel has gained popularity in recent years. However, only a limited number of studies have been conducted to understand this rapidly growing sector. This research paper examines the impact of nature, safety, culture, social interactions, and superstructure on the satisfaction of travelers who travel alone to Bali. Additionally, it explores how digitalization significantly affects the tourism industry, highlighting the importance of e-commerce platforms in solo travelers' planning and booking processes through online travel agencies, AI-driven recommendation systems, and peer-reviewed content. With increased convenience, security, and personalized booking options, mobile payments and social media enhance the solo travel experience. Data from 276 participants was collected via a self-administered questionnaire administered at various tourist locations, employing judgment sampling. Responses were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). According to the findings, nature, culture, and social interactions significantly impact the satisfaction of individuals traveling alone to Bali. However, safety and superstructure (accommodation, food, and transportation) do not significantly affect the satisfaction of solo travelers. The results add to the existing literature on customer loyalty in tourism and provide insights that the Indonesian tourism industry can utilize. These insights can assist stakeholders in developing effective marketing strategies and promoting long-term engagement sustainability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control Systems for Power and Energy Management in Smart Buildings
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In this paper, we present a systematic literature review on the role of intelligent control systems in optimizing power and energy management for smart buildings. Using the PRISMA methodology to ensure the quality of the review, we analyzed 214 relevant articles retrieved from databases such as ScienceDirect, Scopus, Google Scholar, and IEEE Xplore. Our review synthesizes recent findings and identifies trends in the integration of intelligent systems for improving energy efficiency, balancing energy consumption, and enabling smart automation in buildings. This work highlights the latest advances, key research areas, and future opportunities for deploying intelligent control systems to address energy challenges in smart buildings.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Artificial Intelligence Applications with Blockchain Implementation
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence’s (AI) quick development has revolutionized several industries and brought new approaches to automation, data processing, and decision-making. However, obstacles related to data privacy issues, security threats, and model accountability have hindered the realization of its full potential. Blockchain technology, known for its immutable and decentralized nature, has emerged as a potentially viable solution for both problems at the same time. This article contributes an analysis of the interplay between Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence, underscoring their combined capacity to transform applications spanning several industries. We explore specific application scenarios where Blockchain enhances security measures, supports the development of reliable model training, and improves the administration of AI data. Additionally, we delineate the ethical, legal, and technical challenges associated with this integration. We offer perspectives on prospective research directions that could capitalize on this convergence to foster innovation. The findings of this study accentuate the transformative role of Blockchain in augmenting AI applications, ultimately establishing a foundation for a more secure, transparent, and efficient digital framework

articleTitle: The Role of Self-Awareness and Self-Management in Mitigating Burnout and Health Harm among Indonesian Employees: Implications for Organizational Interventions
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study examines how self-awareness and self-management moderate the complex relationship between workplace burnout and health harm. It seeks to understand how these traits affect how burnout affects organizational employee health. A cross-sectional quantitative survey was conducted among 740 Greater Jakarta employees. An online survey with established tools for burnout, health harm, self-awareness, and self-management was used to collect and analyze data using PLS-SEM. The results show that burnout is a major factor affecting employee health. Self-awareness and self-management did not significantly moderate the relationship between burnout and health harm, suggesting that these individual interventions are insufficient to mitigate burnout. This study fills a gap in the literature by examining self-awareness and self-management as moderators of workplace burnout. The findings emphasize the importance of organizational interventions to reduce burnout by addressing workload and support systems. Future research should examine more moderating variables and organizational interventions to reduce burnout and improve employee well-being.

articleTitle: Investigation on the effect of feature extraction block on the performance of EEG-based emotion recognition system
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Emotion recognition from brain signals contributes significantly to various fields, including healthcare, education, entertainment, facilitating emotion regulation and therapeutic interventions. However, existing methods face challenges due to the non-linearity of brain activity, inter/intra-variability, and artifacts. In order to improve emotion recognition from electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, this study addresses aspects related to feature extraction methods. to investigate the effect of feature extraction on the performance of EEG-based emotion recognition, using three feature extraction methods, Hjorth parameters (HP), Higuchi fractal dimension (HFD), and high-order crossing (HOC). The proposed approach is optimized by exploring optimal parameters for HFD and HOC. Extracted features were classified using linear discriminant analysis (LDA) with mutual information for feature selection. The performance of our approach is assessed in the DEAP dataset. The obtained results show that hjorth-base approach outperforms other approaches with an accuracy of 70.48% for the arousal class, and an accuracy of 68.75% for the valence class. demonstrating it’s reliability for EEG-based emotion recognition. HFD and HOC followed, underlining the importance of parameter optimization and the impact of using all 32 EEG channels for emotion classification. The comparison of the proposed approach with some state-of-the-art methods shows the efficacy and superiority of our approach.

articleTitle: Multidisciplinary Design Optimization and Simulation of Multi-Technology Energy Storage Solutions for Sustainable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The move towards achieving net zero emissions is carried out by different countries all over the world by implementing various renewable energy re-sources. As renewable energy resources are intermittent and generate power as per the resources available it becomes crucial to store that generated power to utilize it during high demand. Thus, the implementation of modular energy storage systems operates designed for grid frequency management and demand and supply power balancing functions. However, there are issues with battery energy storage systems as they start to degrade after a long time which affects the loading capability and increases the budget of replacing the battery. This paper provides a study of Hybrid Energy Storage batteries where Mega-Scale Energy Storage and Fast Response Energy Storage is used which provides many advantages over single battery sources. HESS provides benefits such as a balance between generation and demand, flattening intermittency of renewable energy resources, improving power fluctuations, reducing charging, and discharging cycles with high output performance. As it is a combination of two batteries each battery serves its purpose and makes HESS storage suitable for renewable energy systems. The structure, capacity sizing, different converter topologies and characteristics will be discussed for HESS which will provide a strong understanding of Multi-Mode Energy Storage Solutions for sustainable power re-sources.

articleTitle: Real-Time Plant Species Classification Using ResNet-18 and MobileNetV3-Large on Pl@ntNet-300K
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Accurate identification and classification of plant species are essential for environmental conservation, agricultural management, and botanical research. This study explores a deep learning-based approach for automated plant species identification, leveraging the Pl@ntNet-300K dataset. Two pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network architectures, ResNet-18 and MobileNetV3-Large, originally trained on ImageNet, were evaluated based on their classification performance and computational efficiency. MobileNetV3-Large, optimized for resource-constrained devices, demonstrated its suitability for real-time, low-power applications, while ResNet-18 exhibited higher classification accuracy, making it ideal for high-precision biodiversity monitoring. The study highlights the trade-offs between model accuracy and computational efficiency, emphasizing the potential of deep learning for scalable, real-time plant species classification. These findings provide a foundation for future applications in ecology, precision agriculture, and conservation efforts.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence to Formal and Informal Entrepreneurial Projects
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This article explores the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in the development of entrepreneurial projects, whether formal or informal. AI provides significant advantages in terms of operational efficiency, process optimization, and service personalization, while also presenting challenges related to adoption, such as high costs and required technical skills. The study is based on a sample of 50 Moroccan entrepreneurs and examines three main hypotheses: the impact of the nature of the business, the level of AI influence, and the relationship between these two factors. The results show increased use of AI in informal projects, with a positive effect on business activities, particularly in areas of promotion and product creation.

articleTitle: New H∞ Fuzzy MPPT Control of Solar Systems using Descriptor Fuzzy Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to develop a fuzzy maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller that performs well in variable weather photovoltaic (PV) systems. The photovoltaic output voltage can be adjusted using a DC-DC boost converter. The last step is controlled by the duty cycle, which is essentially bounded between 0 and 1 . Using the Lyapunov approach and Descriptor Takagi-Sugeno (DT-S) fuzzy modelling, we establish the stabilisation conditions with H∞ performance represented as linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, we apply the proposed control to a solar system and the results of our simulation validate the efficiency of the presented methods.

articleTitle: A predictive approach based on machine learning for university student re-enrollment
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The primary objective of universities is to ensure the academic success of their students. At Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University (USMBA) in Fez, a study developed a predictive model to assess the risks of non-reenrollment using academic and socio-demographic data such as gender, place of birth, type of high school diploma, and program of study. To tackle this issue, machine learning algorithms like XGBoost, CatBoost, Balanced Random Forest, and EasyEnsembleClassifier were implemented and combined through a StackingClassifier, with the SMOTETomek method addressing class imbalance between reenrolled and non-reenrolled students. The model achieved an accuracy of 77%, excelling in predicting reenrollment (precision: 82%, recall: 92%), though its performance in detecting non-reenrollment was constrained by the diversity within this group. These results underscore the utility of ensemble techniques and resampling methods in identifying at-risk students, offering a solid foundation for dropout prevention and university retention strategies.

articleTitle: TID Controller for Load Frequency Control in Multi-Area Interconnected Systems with High Renewable Energy Penetration Using an Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The global energy transition, marked by the strong mix of renewable sources of energy in power grids, brings big challenges to power system stability. This stability gets affected by the changeable and hard-to-predict output of renewable energy sources that are highly dependent on weather conditions. In order to tackle this problem TID controller has been designed for Load Frequency Control LFC. To optimize the TID controller parameters, Improved Grey Wolf Optimizer (I-GWO) is employed utilizing an Integral Time Absolute Error (ITAE) objective function. The proposed controller is tested on a Three-area power system integrated with photovoltaic (PV) panels and wind turbines representing a high penetration of Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) in modern power systems.The results are compared with those obtained using Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID). The results are compared with those obtained using Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID). The comparison between these two controllers was conducted by evaluating their stability, response speed, and robustness under different system settings and different values of load . The study was organized into four separate cases to make sure a full performance evaluation was done. Using MATLAB/Simulink, the simulation output indicates that the TID controller is marked by a quick correction of frequency and tie-line power variations with low cost much better than the PID controller.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Academic Path Using Machine Learning: Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Machine learning have brought a great revolution for a multitude of industries. In fields like education, ML algorithms offer potential for transforming traditional approaches by improving the monitoring and supervising student progress and identifying learning orientations. While shaping the educational experience of students, predicting academic path has also an essential role for educational institutions. This knowledge enables effective career guidance and allows students to make informed decisions about their education and career paths early on. This article delves into the prediction studies proposed in between 2011 and 2023. The first step was conducting deep researches to identify relevant publications. This search identified a total of 91 publications. Subsequently, each publication went through meticulous evaluation against specific criteria established for the synthesis process. Following this rigorous screening process, 42 publications were found and selected. Across the spectrum of studies analyzed, researchers showcased a diverse range of ML techniques used to forecast student’s performance and anticipate their future academic trajectories. These techniques span from traditional algorithms such as decision trees and logistic regression to more advanced models including neural networks and ensemble methods. Furthermore, many studies concentrated on feature selection methodologies to augment the accuracy and robustness of their analyses. The conclusions reflect that Machine Learning methods have been shown to be crucial in predicting students pathway, thus improving the students’ performance.

articleTitle: Strain-Controllable High Curie Temperature, Monte Carlo Simulation, and Magnetic Crystal Anisotropy in a 2D Ferromagnetic Janus 2H-CrOBr Monolayer
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the realm of spintronics, the significance of two-dimensional (2D) intrinsic ferromagnetic materials cannot be overstated. Our focus is on examining a monolayer (ML) Janus 2H −CrOBr that exhibits intrinsic ferromagnetism, using density functional theory. Our study delves into the effects of bi − axial strain on the magnetic and electronic characteristics of Janus CrOBr, revealing intriguing alterations in its electronic properties under strain. Our computations establish that this monolayer manifests ferromagnetic (FM) ground states characterized by notably high Curie temperatures. By subjecting CrOBr to biaxial strain, we can transition it from a ferromagnetic metal to a ferromagnetic half-metal (HM). Remarkably, this manipulation also enables the adjustment of the associated Curie temperature (T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>), varying from 341 K (-6%) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">to 131 K (-12%).</sup> Moreover, the strain sensitivity of the easy axes (EA) and hard axes is evident, alongside the controlled modulation of the magnetocrystalline anisotropy (MCA) energy, which fluctuates from -1.890erg/cm2 (-12%) to -4.060 erg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (-9%). This comprehensive investigation illustrates magnetic and electronic phase transitions within confined CrOBr, presenting an avenue for exploring controllable electronic and magnetic properties critical in the field of electronics and spintronics applications.

articleTitle: The impact of implementing an ISO 14001 environmental management system in manufacturing industries: Role and contribution to improved environmental performance - a systematic review of studies
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Over the past decade, the manufacturing industry has made significant progress, supported by increased production, favorable public policies, and growing demand. At the same time, environmental sustainability has become a key issue, prompting companies to monitor and improve their environmental performance. This systematic review of empirical research, covering studies published between 2020 and 2024, aims to assess the impact of implementing the ISO 14001 Environmental Management System (EMS) in manufacturing industries. Although this system provides a framework for improving environmental performance, its effectiveness depends on several factors, such as sustainable accounting, the complexity of its implementation, the costs involved, and the availability of resources, particularly in developing countries. EMSs have a positive impact on relations with regulators, customers, and communities, as well as improving employee motivation and investor perception. Although the economic benefits are modest, strategic implementation can lead to improved overall performance and sustainable results. This study highlights the importance of adopting critical and diverse approaches capable of challenging the optimistic discourse surrounding the impact of this system, and emphasizes the practical implications for managers and professionals in the sector.

articleTitle: Signal Processing Analysis of Lamb Wave Propagation in Stainless Steel Plates with Thickness Defects: Implications for AI-Based Non-Destructive Testing
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study investigates the interaction of Lamb waves with defects in a 304 stainless steel plate using numerical simulations in the commercial software Abaqus. We model four different configurations: a healthy plate, a plate with a single-sided 10% thickness loss, a plate with a 30% thickness loss, and a plate with symmetrical 10 % thickness loss on both sides. Lamb wave propagation is excited at 2100 kHz.mm, focusing on the A0 mode. Using 2D Fast Fourier Transform (2D-FFT) analysis, we compare analytical dispersion curves with those obtained numerically, examining incident, transmitted, and reflected modes across different defect scenarios.The results reveal that defect size and symmetry significantly influence mode conversion, reflection, and transmission, especially for the A0 and A1 modes. Larger defects lead to stronger interactions, while symmetrical defects show distinct transmission and reflection patterns compared to single-sided losses.These findings provide valuable insights into guided wave behavior in the presence of defects and offer a foundation for developing robust datasets. Such datasets have the potential to be used in AI-based non-destructive testing (NDT) applications, facilitating automated defect detection and structural health monitoring. This work contributes to the advancement of both traditional and AI-enhanced NDT methods, aiming to improve defect detection accuracy and efficiency in critical engineering structures.

articleTitle: Successive Interference Cancellation in NOMA For 5G communication system
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The combination of Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) with Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) has proven to be a highly effective approach in 5G communication systems. With the increasing demands for high data rates, massive connectivity, and improved spectral efficiency, the integration of SIC and NOMA in 5G has garnered significant attention. SIC in NOMA enables the decoding and cancellation of interference iteratively, enabling multiple users to efficiently utilize the same time-frequency resources. The signal from the user with the strongest channel is decoded initially and subsequently removed from the received signal. Weaker users' signals can be progressively recovered. This approach enhances user fairness and capacity, as weaker users can still be served even in the presence of stronger users. Throughout this paper, we discuss the principles and attributes of SIC in NOMA systems, along with the consequences of imperfect SIC implementation. Besides, the study concentrates on employing SC (Superposition Coding) techniques at the transmitter and SIC methods at the receiver, we will use Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) modulation with two users and we have implemented a fixed power allocation (PA) strategy. Moreover, we do SIC for decoding superposition coded signal. The obtained results concludes that NOMA is functioning as intended, effectively combining two separate sets of data in the power domain and successfully retrieving both of them. Additionally, we propose MIMO with SIC-NOMA as a substitute approach, to enhance the system capacity and spectral efficiency. This involves exploring optimal beamforming, precoding, and user grouping strategies to exploit the spatial domain for improved performance.

articleTitle: “A Task Offloading and Edge Computing Framework for Enhanced Energy Efficiency and Reduced Latency in IoT Image Recognition Applications”
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized many areas, but it also presents new challenges, particularly in energy efficiency. IoT devices are often small, with limited battery life, making energy-saving solutions crucial. Edge computing, along with task offloading, has become a key strategy to improve energy efficiency while maintaining good performance. This paper explores some offloading methods, like edge computing (EC), and cloud computing, to reduce energy use while addressing latency and network traffic issues. We present a mathematical model that evaluates the balance between energy, speed, and bandwidth, supported by extensive simulations. The results show that edge computing offloading can significantly reduce energy consumption and lower latency in the IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: State of the Art in Modeling, Prototyping, and Testing Approaches for Hybrid Composite Materials Research
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Hybrid composites materials, which mix various reinforcements and matrices to attain superior mechanical and functional qualities. Despite being widely employed in the healthcare, automotive, and aerospace industries, they provide difficulties with precise modeling, effective prototyping, and trustworthy testing. Key modeling approaches, such as finite element and micromechanical methods, as well as sophisticated prototyping strategies, such as additive manufacturing, are compiled in this review. Additionally, it emphasizes experimental techniques for confirming structural integrity and performance, future directions involving digital tools and intelligent design are considered, along with existing limits and research gaps, the objective is to direct future advancement in creating high-performance hybrid composite.

articleTitle: User Experience Evaluation of the BPK RI Portal: A Combined UEQ and Heuristic Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study evaluates the User Experience (UX) of the Audit Board of the Republic of Indonesia (BPK RI) portal using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) and Heuristic Evaluation methods. The research addresses critical usability issues identified in the portal, such as disorganized information architecture and excessive scrolling, which hinder users' efficiency and satisfaction. A mixed-method approach was employed to assess the portal's UX comprehensively. The UEQ collected quantitative data on user satisfaction from 100 respondents representing organisational stakeholder, while the Heuristic Evaluation, conducted by expert evaluators using Jakob Nielsen’s principles, identified 124 critical usability issues. Key findings revealed consistently low scores across major UX dimensions, including Attractiveness, Perspicuity, and Dependability, highlighting significant gaps in user trust and system performance. To address these shortcomings, actionable recommendations were proposed, improving visual aesthetics, streamlining navigation, enhancing user control, and increasing system reliability. These improvements are expected to provide a more intuitive and satisfying user experience. By addressing these issues, the study improves the usability and functionality of the BPK RI portal and enhances operational efficiency and productivity within the organization. Additionally, this research serves as a benchmark for evaluating and improving UX in government systems, offering insights and methodologies that can be adapted to similar institutional contexts, thereby advancing best practices in public-sector technology.

Author Keywords: Audit Board of the Republic of Indonesia (BPK RI)

articleTitle: Predicting Student’s Academic Performance in a Learning Management System Platform Using Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Learning Management Systems (LMS) facilitate systematic teaching in various learning environments, ensuring continuity regardless of disruptions. These platforms allow students to attend classes, participate in discussions, and submit weekly tasks, mitigating concerns about class disturbances. However, research indicates that while LMS benefits many students, others face significant challenges due to various factors. This study explores how conventional factors—such as personal information, personality type, study habits, digital resources, and internet accessibility—impact academic performance among students in the College of Computing Studies and the College of Social Work and Community Development. Furthermore, this research aims to develop a new ensemble-based model that leverages bagging and boosting techniques to enhance predictive accuracy. The study adopts an experimental research design to identify the most effective model. Findings indicate that the boosting model outperforms other ensemble methods in predicting academic success. Additionally, hypothesis testing using ANOVA confirms a significant positive relationship between these factors and academic performance. However, this study recommends future research with a larger and more balanced dataset to improve the reliability of findings. Future work should explore advanced data balancing techniques, such as Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), to address dataset imbalances and enhance model generalization. Additionally, optimizing ensemble models through hyperparameter tuning using Grid Search, Random Search, or Bayesian Optimization can refine performance and predictive accuracy.

articleTitle: Study of the Roles of IoT in the Transformation of Supplier Relationships in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This communication aims to report on achievements to date, through an analysis based on published research papers that address the impact of IoT on suppliers and stakeholders in general. It will highlight the benefits, the obstacles encountered and practical strategies to overcome these challenges and successfully integrate IoT into supplier processes. A SWOT analysis of the fundamental IoT technologies, namely IoT Sensors and RFID technology shed light on their differences and functions which are often integrated together to improve automation and resource management in Industry 4.0. In this paper, a special focus is made on interoperability in the smart factory and its partners. Indeed, interoperability in Industry 4.0 is a fundamental lever to increase efficiency, flexibility and collaboration within industrial systems. It is based on the harmonious integration of technologies, data and processes between machines, software and different stakeholders. Nevertheless, the need to address the challenges of cybersecurity, standardization and data management remains imperative in order to fully exploit its potential and build a resilient and sustainable industrial ecosystem.

articleTitle: Prescriptive Analytics for Logistics: Bridging Predictive Models and Actionable Decisions Through Advanced Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Modern logistics is facing increasing challenges due to the growing complexity of supply chains, high consumer expectations, and economic and environmental pressures. While predictive analytics, powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and massive data, has transformed the ability to forecast trends and risks, its application remains limited by the lack of effective mechanisms to convert these predictions into actionable decisions in dynamic and constrained environments. This paper proposes an innovative hybrid approach that combines advanced predictive models, notably the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), with prescriptive algorithms, such as linear programming and deep reinforcement learning (DRL). The TFT demonstrated superior performance in terms of predictive accuracy (significant reduction in MAE, RMSE, and MAPE), while the prescriptive algorithms optimized complex logistics decisions in real time, even in uncertain environments. This integrated methodology was validated through use cases simulating critical logistics scenarios, such as delivery route optimization. Experimental results show a substantial improvement in operational efficiency, with reductions in costs, lead times and resource utilization. The prescriptive approach made it possible to automate complex decisions, while taking into account multiple constraints, such as costs, lead times and sustainability objectives. By integrating real-time data collected via IoT devices and logistics management systems, this architecture offers a robust, adaptable and scalable solution. It thus meets the requirements of modern logistics by enabling proactive, optimized and resilient decision-making. This research makes a significant contribution by bridging the gap between predictive and prescriptive analysis, while laying the foundations for new applications in the field of intelligent logistics.

articleTitle: Transforming Indonesian Workplaces: Exploring the Interplay of AI Experience, AI-Based Engagement, and Employee Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This study examines the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Experience on employee engagement and well-being, exploring how AI engagement mediates this relationship in Indonesian workplaces. A cross-sectional survey was conducted with 479 employees in Greater Jakarta, utilizing Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) to analyze the relationships between AI Experience, AI Engagement, and AI Well-Being. The results indicate that AI Experience significantly enhances AI Engagement and AI Well-Being. Additionally, AI Engagement positively influences AI Well-Being, and acts as a mediator between AI Experience and AI Well-Being. This study fills a gap in existing research by exploring AI engagement as a mediating factor between AI experience and employee well-being, providing insights into how positive interactions with AI technologies can enhance workplace outcomes. Organizations should focus on creating intuitive AI systems and provide comprehensive training to enhance AI engagement, which can improve employee well-being. The findings suggest that AI adoption should prioritize employee engagement to maximize both productivity and mental well-being. Future research could explore cross-cultural variations and the long-term impact of AI on work environments.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Structural Reliability Analysis of Steel Truss Bridges
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become an essential technology in civil engineering, enabling innovative approaches to solving complex problems, optimizing decision-making processes, and enhancing efficiency in design, analysis, and construction management. Within this scope, the primary objective of this paper is to evaluate the potential of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) as an efficient predictive model for analyzing the structural response of steel Pratt truss bridges, specifically within the context of reliability analysis. A conceptual Pratt bridge configuration with twelve panels is considered alongside structural data generated from 84 cases under varying geometric and loading conditions. The ANN model is trained to predict the maximum tensile and compressive forces in key truss elements, including diagonal, lower, vertical, and upper chords, using input parameters such as truss geometry and applied forces. In addition, while comparing the ANN predictions against classical methods, the study further employs Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) to assess the probability of failure and reliability index of the most loaded structural elements. The study demonstrates the ANN's capability to deliver accurate predictions with reduced computational costs, highlighting its potential for integration into advanced structural analysis frameworks.

articleTitle: Classification of industrial accidents in the energy sector using machine learning models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper aims to develop a machine learning based predictive model for detecting fatal and non-fatal industrial accidents in the energy sector. Four machine learning models such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), Naïve Bayes (NB) and Random Forest (RF) were evaluated to identify the most suitable model. In addition, three feature extraction models—Bag of Words (BoW), TF-IDF and Word2Vec—were applied with the machine learning models to obtain a powerful model for fatal and non-fatal accident classification. The most popular metrics—accuracy, precision, F1-score and recall—were employed to assess the models. Testing confirmed that the achievement level amounted to 97% success. The investigation establishes the capability of machine learning to support energy sector safety management operations. The research results can support accident prevention through risk factor identification and safety hazard awareness improvement while enabling quantitative fatal and non-fatal accident predictions for better safety management system implementation.

articleTitle: IoT Security in the Quantum Era: State of the Art and Open Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has grown rapidly, transforming various aspects of daily life into intelligent systems capable of collecting and exchanging data in real time. At the same time, advances in quantum computing have given rise to powerful quantum computers capable of processing complex tasks at unprecedented speed. This disparity between the limited resources of IoT devices and the capabilities of quantum computers poses significant security challenges. Quantum computers introduce new vulnerabilities that threaten IoT systems, particularly in critical applications such as connected healthcare, industrial networks, smart infrastructure, and secure embedded systems. This study reviews the existing literature on post-quantum cryptography (PQC) applied to IoT devices. It analyzes the characteristics and security requirements of IoT environments, current security technologies, and unresolved issues. It highlights the growing threat of post-quantum attacks and the need to adapt security strategies. Finally, the study explores post-quantum code-based cryptosystems as solutions to enhance the security of resource-constrained IoT applications and ensure their resilience against future challenges.

articleTitle: Differential SAR Interferometric Phase Map Denoising Using Hybrid Convolutional-Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid deep learning approach for speckle noise reduction from differential synthetic aperture radar (SAR) interferometric phase maps. Differential interferometric SAR (DInSAR) is a powerful technique for detecting and quantifying surface deformations; however, the obtained phase maps are corrupted by speckle noise, topographic contributions, and atmospheric artifacts. Effective speckle denoising is crucial for the accurate extraction of the desired deformation information. The proposed method, called Hybrid Convolutional-Attention Network (HCA-Net), combines convolutional neural networks (CNN) and vision transformers (ViT) in a two-stage architecture. First, a modified U-Net model performs initial despeckling of the input DInSAR phase map. Then, the denoised phase map is fed into a Swin Transformer adapted with a masked self-attention mechanism, which further refines the denoising while preserving fine details and discontinuities related to surface deformations. Experimental results on simulated and real DInSAR data demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming traditional techniques in terms of quantitative metrics such as peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and edge preservation index (EPI). Our HCA-Net achieves improvements of 4-6 dB in PSNR, and significantly higher SSIM (0.96) and EPI (0.94) compared to classical methods (0.85 and 0.84 respectively), enabling more reliable deformation measurements for geological and environmental monitoring applications.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Regression Model for Predicting Students’ Performance with Shapley Additive Explanations-based Interpretability
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Predicting student performance is crucial for identifying at-risk students, guiding educational interventions, and improving student outcomes. In this study, we developed a deep learning regression model to predict students’ performance in Moroccan baccalaureate exams and evaluated the model’s reliability using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations). Our model was trained and evaluated with a large dataset of 342.268 students. The model achieved notable performance, with a Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.238, a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.482, and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.377 on the test set. An R-squared score of 0.741 indicates that the model explains 74.1% of the data’s variance on the test set, highlighting its reliability in real-world educational contexts. Additionally, the Mean Bias Error (MBE) was near zero (0.0027 on the test set), demonstrating that the model’s predictions are unbiased and neither systematically overestimate nor underestimate student performance. We assessed the importance of features using permutation-based analysis and SHAP values to understand which features most significantly influenced predictions. Results highlighted that the "Regional Exam" score was the dominant factor, followed by features such as "first-semester average" and "Subject-related continuous assessment scores." This study demonstrates the potential of deep learning models in educational prediction and the importance of explainable AI(XAI) in interpreting complex model predictions and supporting educators and policymakers in decision-making.

articleTitle: Improving a Speech Emotion Recognition System for Saudi Dialect
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a challenging and essential task, particularly for underrepresented languages and dialects. This study introduces an improved SER system specifically designed for the Saudi dialect, addressing significant challenges such as data scarcity and imbalanced datasets. To tackle these issues, advanced data augmentation techniques—such as noise addition, volume adjustment, and time shifting—are applied to enhance dataset diversity and model robustness. The feature extraction process utilizes Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), which effectively capture the key characteristics of speech signals. These features are then processed using traditional machine learning classifiers, including KNN, SVM, and LDA, as well as deep learning models such as CNN and MLP. The experimental results reveal significant improvements in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores across all classifiers after implementing data augmentation. Among the classifiers, LDA and CNN achieve the highest accuracy of 96.19%, showcasing the efficacy of tailored data augmentation strategies in advancing SER for the Saudi dialect.

articleTitle: Energy Audit of the Water Steam Circuit Using the ISO 50001 Standard: Application Sulfuric Acid Production Process
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Population growth, climate change, and cultural water usage style exacerbate water and energy resource scarcities. The energy and water saving is a specially important topic in the industrial sector nowadays. For this reason, the present paper aims to improve the energy efficiency of the water-steam circuit of the sulfuric acid production process following the International Standard ISO 50001. In this perspective, an energy diagnosis has been realized in order to analyze the energy consumption of the site using a statistical analysis. Then, it energetically integrates the process of sulfuric acid, and tries to recover the heat released using the Pinch methodology. This study enabled us to deduce the optimal steam network which controls expansion valves that are often left open for no reason, and solves tripping problems. The energy integration using the pinch method was carried out to design an optimal heat exchange network, with a minimum number of exchange units. We noticed that the number of heat exchangers can be reduced significatly using advanced technologies.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance of offshore wind farms based on OPC UA and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Offshore wind farms is playing an essential role in reducing carbon emissions, diversifying energy portfolios, and promoting a green transition toward renewable energy, giving a clean and sustainable source of power. As wind turbines continue to grow in size, this makes the process and maintenance of wind turbines more and more complicated. This shows significant challenges due to harsh environmental conditions such as strong winds. This raises maintenance costs, and the critical need for uninterrupted energy production, which underscores the importance of efficient maintenance strategies for the economic sustainability of offshore wind farms. Predictive maintenance, powered by OPC UA and machine learning, offers an advantage approach to wind turbine maintenance. By analyzing real-time operational , data to anticipate failures before they occur, this contributes to reduce downtime, and optimizes operational efficiency. This paper utilizes a predictive model based on a Random Forest algorithm (RFA). The model is implemented using Spyder environment, the obtained results, validated based on metrics values, are promising.

articleTitle: An AI-Driven Workflow for Preserving Traditional Malay Music Videos: A Case Study in Cultural Heritage Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Preserving cultural heritage like traditional arts and traditional music becomes increasingly challenging during the digital age. We presented a workflow that uses generative AI to preserve traditional Malay music in video format with an emphasis on cultural integrity through photorealistic video generation. Our enhanced framework uses Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) combined with Splitter.ai-based vocal isolation and Kling.ai motion synchronization along with other artificial intelligence techniques to completely process and enhance audiovisual elements. We started our research design by deploying generative AI tools throughout a production process starting from concept development, facial synthesis, and training alongside motion-lip synchronization before post-production to ensure visual harmony without sacrificing storytelling elements and technical precision. The workflow consists of expert validation points, loop refinement linked to cultural accuracy loss, and computational performance. The end results show that generative AI techniques create successful links between traditional artistic forms with the present multimedia formats to preserve traditional Malay music. This research introduces a workflow that allows reproducible AI-assisted preservation methods which give opportunities to heritage experts and authorities helpful guidance to integrate technical innovations with cultural integrity.

articleTitle: Leveraging BERT Models for Toxicity Detection in Moroccan Dialect
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The widespread use of social media and increased internet accessibility have led to the generation of vast amounts of data. Much of the online textual content consists of informal expressions of opinions by individuals, which often include hateful language. The advent of transformer-based models has greatly enhanced addressing such challenges in textual data. With their ability to process context bidirectionally and handle large-scale data efficiently, transformers have revolutionized natural language processing, particularly in tasks such as classifying online comments. From this perspective, this study has been conducted to deploy transformer-based models to identify harmful statements written in the Moroccan dialect (Darija), which poses unique challenges due to its informal and diverse linguistic nature. The Moroccan Arabic Toxic Comments Dataset (MATCD), gathered using Selenium, serves as the foundation for this study, enabling the evaluation of transformer-based models in detecting harmful comments in the Moroccan dialect. As the interest in the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model increased, several model variations were developed to adjust to different languages, including Arabic, to enhance the ability to handle language-specific tasks effectively. The experimental results exhibit the strengths and weaknesses of each approach, with the model achieving high accuracy, reaching up to 95%, providing valuable insight into the suitability and effectiveness of transformer-based models in this domain.

articleTitle: State of Agile software development in the moroccan context and Integration of AI: A systematic review (SLR)
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The emergence of artificial intelligence offers promising prospects. The integration of AI into the various practices of agile software development should increase productivity, efficiency, quality, innovation and minimize project delays through the automation of routine tasks. AI also brings with it a central ethical challenge. Objective This study aims to determine future guidelines and gaps relating to the alliance of artificial intelligence and agility in software development, and more specifically in the Moroccan context, the authors stated that an analysis of studies established in the past and present is crucial, even inevitable, to establish and build a foundation for the future. Methodology We followed the guidelines recommended by Kitchenham to produce a systematic review. We examined 1308 papers, 16 of which were directly relevant to our problem. Six databases were chosen: IEEEXPLORE, SCOPUS, Web of Science, ACM, Science direct and DBLP. Results The results show that the perception and adoption of agility depend first and foremost on the context, the corporate culture and the mindset of teams, but also on customer requirements and the nature of projects. The benefits, challenges and barriers to adopting agility in Morocco are in line with existing literature. The application of AI in agile software development projects in Morocco remains a notable gap in the literature.

articleTitle: DeepArabicDoc: A Hybrid CNN-LSTM Framework for Multi-Scale Enhancement and Semantic Analysis of Historical Arabic Manuscripts
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper introduces the novel structure for processing historical Arabic documents in integrating multi scale enhancement skills with semantic analysis. The proposed approach utilizes the combination of modern image processing techniques and deep-learning models including LSTM and CNN architectures to these challenges of degraded historical manuscripts. The framework employs the two-stage methodology: multi scale document development for improving the text readability and feature extraction optimization to boost recognition accuracy. Experimental validation on the VML HD dataset demonstrates a significant 30% improvement in feature extraction accuracy compared to baseline methods with the development of module successfully handling 76.9% of heavily degraded documents. The LSTM model achieved a test accuracy of 91.09% and a loss of 0.2926 showcasing its effectiveness in capturing semantic dependencies. With an average processing time of 1.5 seconds per page and this framework is efficient and scalable highly suitable for large scale digitization and analysis of historical Arabic texts. These results highlight the potential of the proposed system to increase the preservation and accessibility of cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Harnessing Data-Driven Approaches for Robust Real-Time Fraud Prevention and Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Transaction fraud is a serious concern to financial institutions and customers in the constantly shifting fintech ecosystem. Through the growing trend of digital payments, fraudsters exploit weaknesses in real time, demanding speedy and precise detection techniques. This study investigates the essential topic of real-time payment identification of fraud within the fintech industry, where typical batch-processing approaches cannot handle rising risks quickly. We provide an architecture that leverages the synergies of Apache Kafka, Apache Spark Streaming, and machine learning to enable proactive detection and mitigation of fraudulent behaviors as they occur. This study proposes a scalable platform that assists financial firms in combating fraud, securing assets, and maintaining confidence in digital transactions.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Intelligent Control Approaches in Building Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Effective building energy management is crucial for mitigating climate change and reducing energy costs. This review focuses on intelligent control methods for optimizing building energy consumption, drawing on recent research from international publications. It examines various strategies, including fuzzy logic control, neural network-predictive control, and reinforcement learning, highlighting their features, advantages, and limitations. The review addresses key challenges, such as controlling complex and unpredictable building systems. Future research directions are explored, emphasizing the development of adaptive, robust, and nonlinear control techniques. This includes integrating machine learning and data-driven approaches to enhance performance, adaptability, and resilience.

articleTitle: Two-factor biometric authentication system based on facial recognition using the SVC model: The case of SENEGAL
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The development of digital technologies has profoundly transformed authentication methods, particularly in the context of online examinations and other related areas such as electronic transactions. Electronic signatures, while effective, face security challenges such as identity theft and fraud. This paper proposes an innovative solution by integrating facial recognition with the electronic signature, thus combining a secret code and biometrics to guarantee the authenticity of the signatory. We propose a secure solution using advanced technologies such as Deep Learning with the SVC (Support Vector Classifier) model for facial recognition. Tests on a real dataset have shown that the classification approach outperforms traditional direct comparison methods. This article highlights the importance of integrating biometrics into electronic signature systems to enhance security. It also highlights the need to adapt these technologies to the Senegalese context, where the digital transition and citizens' confidence in digital tools are crucial to encouraging their adoption.

articleTitle: A Scoping Review of Machine Learning Techniques for Early Autism Detection and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 5th International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that affects social interactions and is characterized by the repetition of certain behaviors by an individual. Timely diagnosis and treatment can lead to effective interventions.
